Marissa —

Great to chat. Short answers from AP/procurement side:

- Payment method: Our preferred flow for software vendors is PO/ACH for recurring contracts. Corporate card can be used for one-off purchases and pilot invoices under $10k, but anything above that requires a PO and our purchase order workflow.
- Vendor onboarding: We require a completed vendor form, a W-9, and our security/compliance questionnaire for any new vendor. We use an internal vendor portal and sometimes accept emailed forms for smaller vendors.
- Marketplaces: We are open to purchasing via AWS Marketplace, that often speeds procurement, but it depends on whether the pricing and contract terms are equivalent.
- Timeline: Typical vendor onboarding is 2–4 weeks once we have the vendor packet and a commercial/kbi review.

I attached the vendor form and a short procurement checklist. I'll coordinate with Mark (IT procurement) and Helen (security) for the next steps — looping them in here.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Head of Finance Operations
